goal: I want to compare my photos, choose my five favorites, leave any editing notes, and confidently send my selection to the photographer.
workflow: View current shortlist or empty state
If in Draft: add/remove photos, edit notes
If in Submitted: view locked selection and timestamp
firstView: Current shortlist of selected photos with count indicator
primaryAction: Submit selection when exactly five photos are chosen

sections.title: Selection Summary
sections.purpose: Shows current selection status and number of photos chosen

sections.title: Photo List
sections.purpose: Displays all selected photos in order with editing notes

sections.title: Actions
sections.purpose: Provides options to submit or start over

states.loading: Shows skeleton loaders while initializing selection data
states.empty: Displays empty state with call-to-action to return to Gallery
states.error: Shows error alert if selection data fails to load
states.success: Displays submitted confirmation with timestamp and photo list

responsive: Stacks vertically on mobile, maintains grid layout on desktop
accessibility: Keyboard navigation through photo list, screen reader labels for all buttons and status indicators
